descriptionHtml:
Redragon Ebony M998-STD Ultra-Lightweight Wireless Gaming Mouse

Take absolute control of your gameplay and hit every target with the Redragon Ebony M998-STD Ultra-Lightweight Wireless Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-tier gaming peripheral is expertly engineered for esports-level precision, boasting a flagship PixArt PAW3395 optical sensor that tracks up to an incredible 26,000 DPI. It stands as the definitive choice for competitive FPS gamers and power users across Egypt looking for an advanced hardware modification to minimize wrist fatigue and speed up high-velocity visual tracking configurations.

The Redragon Ebony M998-STD features a versatile 3-mode connectivity system, allowing seamless transitions between low-latency 2.4GHz wireless, stable Bluetooth, and a reliable wired USB-C setup. Built with an ergonomic micro-textured shell, it ensures a secure, slip-resistant grip during intense everyday desktop gaming sessions. Outfitted with premium high-durability switches, programmable macro buttons, and low-friction PTFE feet, it delivers a perfectly smooth, ultra-responsive, and completely lag-free digital gaming ecosystem.
